concerns.text: T004 embeds an escape hatch: 'scale to a few-hundred-clip pilot on the free GPU budget if the full 50 k × 54 × 5 run exceeds it'. FR-001/FR-002 mandate ≥50,000 clips × 54 scenarios × 5 models on a paid 4×V100 cluster within 72 h (SC-004). A task that may deliver a few-hundred-clip run while tagged [FR-002] silently weakens the requirement; the spec nowhere authorizes downscaling.

T009 replaces FR-018's DNS-Challenge realism validation (LMSD ≤ 0.15 pass criterion, ±1 dB/±0.1 s matching) with a Voices-in-the-Wild proxy that has NO pass criterion and drops the ≤0.15 threshold entirely. The spec was never amended; the task weakens a MUST-level FR while claiming to cover it ('FR-018 as amended by plan' — the plan cannot amend the spec).

T007's regression target is 'inflection_step' (per regression_input.schema.yaml), but FR-005 mandates predicting the Universal Collapse Intensity (FR-036). The task trains on a different target variable than the FR it tags; the spec/plan/contract disagree on the target and the task resolves the conflict in the wrong direction.

T007 includes 'baseline WER' as a regression predictor; FR-005/FR-028 enumerate only acoustic parameters, interaction terms, and transcript perplexity — baseline WER is not authorized. Additionally, critical_vector.schema.yaml (which T007 must conform to) requires a coeff_baseline_sss field, directly contradicting FR-028's 'Baseline SSS is NOT used as a covariate'.

T008 computes cosine similarity of each model's vector 'to the cross-model mean', but FR-051/SC-005 specify similarity between the critical interaction vectors across ASR models (pairwise). Similarity-to-mean is not the specified quantity and can pass where pairwise similarity fails.

concerns.location: tasks.md (no task) vs spec.md:US-3 Independent Test
concerns.text: US-3's independent test requires 'a model-agnostic SHAP analysis must be performed to confirm the form of interaction'. No task in tasks.md implements or verifies SHAP; the deliverable is dropped entirely from the task list.

FR-016 requires the human-validation gate to be 'performed as a pre-study gate before US-1 execution', but the dependency table orders T002 (US-1 data acquisition, FR-001) before T003 (the gate). The task ordering violates the spec's sequencing constraint.

SC-004 defines wall-time budgets (48 h pilot / 72 h full run on the GPU cluster); neither T004 nor T010 records or verifies any wall-time measurement, so the acceptance criterion has no surviving verification step.
